_about: Offline upstream docs. Edit this list, then run scripts/sync_upstream_docs.py on a machine that can reach the git host. 'paths' are folders in the repo; 'root_files' are extra files from the repo root; 'include' / 'exclude' are patterns on paths inside those folders. 'license' is used when the repo has no license file; 'extra_extensions' adds file types beyond the usual text ones. 'convert' (rst | adoc) turns each page into one self-contained Markdown file; 'checkout' adds folders needed only during conversion (shared code examples).
